handbookNote: Florida Statutes Chapter 117 (Notaries Public), Part I (General Provisions, ss. 117.01-117.108) and Part II (Online Notarizations, ss. 117.201-117.305). Florida notaries are unusual among states in that they are appointed and commissioned by the Governor (not the Secretary of State), per Fla. Stat. Sec. 117.01(1); grounded in the Executive Office of the Governor's 2019 Governor's Reference Manual for Notaries Public plus the official Florida Statutes text at leg.state.fl.us. Priced at $0.99 (2026-08-16 directive): FL has no confirmed graded assessment of any kind (3-hour course only), so this is education-only practice content, not exam prep -- priced accordingly, well below the $9.99 exam-state tier.
